mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_PHONE, MEMBER_BIRTH, MEMBER_ADDR, MEMBER_ADDR_DETAIL ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberPw}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberBirth}, #{memberAddr}, #{memberAddrDetail} )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_EMAIL , MEMBER_PASSWORD , MEMBER_ROLE FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET REFRESH_TOKEN = NULL, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY = NULL WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail}
UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_STATUS = 'INACTIVE', REFRESH_TOKEN = NULL, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY=NULL WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ROLE = 'ROLE_MANAGER'
